approval.rule: Every Monday at 9am UK this run fires on its own (same pattern as the New Order Agent). Trawl company OneDrive for info@southcoastrods.onmicrosoft.com. Pull new media@ catch reports only — never reuse a catch that has already been posted. If there are no new reports, fill the week from existing OneDrive SCR/ST pictures. Then SMS both approvers. One APPROVE covers every post that week. On REJECT, apply the SMS changes and ask again. Do not schedule until one of them approves.

posts.title: Catch: Craig Startin 36lb
posts.body: Turning up to his syndicate blind with no shows and only the wind to go on, Craig Startin managed to winkle out this stunning 36lb stunner!

posts.body: The ST13 is the casting tool in the range. Carp fishing rod first — with the backbone to hit range when you need it. Over 200 metres on the casting field. Semi-fast special taper, progressive curve, power in the butt, forgiveness in the tip.

variants.instagram:

ST13 is a carp rod that can go long. 13ft 3.75lb. Over 200 metres on the field. Still forgives them under the tip.

If you want a through-action rod for light leads, this is not it.

Shop ST13: https://southcoastrods.com/products/scr-st13-carp-rods

ST10 for close work and boats. ST13 when you need to go long. ST12 for everything in between.
